summary: Frontend-only re-verification focused on the NEW two-panel responsive auth layout for /login, /password/forgot, /password/reset, /invitation/accept, plus light regression of login-safety behaviours. DESKTOP 1440x900: all 4 pages render the branded LEFT panel (green, with heading 'One trusted workspace for every school role.', SECURE SCHOOL ECOSYSTEM eyebrow, and the three feature cards: Tenant isolated / Role controlled / Audited changes) + the RIGHT form card (Sign in / Reset your password / Choose a new password / Accept your invitation). Required data-testids reset-password-toggle and accept-password-toggle are present. MOBILE 402x860: /password/forgot and /invitation/accept collapse to a single centred card, the brand panel is hidden (display:none on brandPanel), and there is NO horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth). No technical/raw error text (no stack traces, JSON, 'exception', '502', 'fetch', 'undefined') found on any page. REGRESSION on /login (via preview-WAF proxy workaround identical to iteration_1 to allow hydration): empty submit shows inline 'Please enter your email address.' (login-email-error) and 'Please enter your password.' (login-password-error); login-password-toggle flips input type password->text; login-help-toggle opens login-help-panel with the expected help copy including 'Passwords are case-sensitive.'. /password/forgot empty submit shows 'Please enter your email address.' (forgot-email-error). All 8 requested behaviours confirmed for /login and /password/forgot end-to-end. For /password/reset (short-password error) and /invitation/accept (password toggle), the required data-testids and safe copy 'At least 12 characters' were confirmed by SSR + testid discovery, but interactive assertions (toggle flip, reset-password-error visibility on 'short' input) intermittently did not fire in this run due to the same preview-ingress WAF blocking of vite dev-server module URLs containing URL-encoded null bytes (%00 / __x00__) — this is the identical infra-only issue documented in iteration_1.json and is NOT a code defect. No source files were modified.

integration_issues.issue: React hydration is silently failing in real browsers on the preview URL because vite-rsc virtual module requests (paths containing __x00__ / %00) return 403 from the preview ingress WAF. Impact this iteration: could not click-verify reset-password-toggle flip and reset-password-error 'Please choose a password with at least 12 characters.' via a real browser without a route-interception proxy. Same infra issue as iteration_1; SSR HTML and data-testids are correct.

issues: Two-panel branded layout is now consistent across /login, /password/forgot, /password/reset, /invitation/accept. Matches the requested design language. Previous iteration_1 note about helper pages looking lighter than /login is now resolved.

action_items: INFRA (carry-over from iteration_1, NOT a code bug): The preview ingress/WAF returns 403 for URL paths containing %00 (e.g. /@id/__x00__virtual:vite-rsc/entry-browser). Real browsers hitting the preview URL cannot hydrate — validation/toggles only work under a Playwright route-interception proxy. Whitelist %00 on the dev module route, OR serve `vite build` output for the preview, OR patch vinext to avoid NUL in virtual ids. Does not affect a production build.
No source-code action items for the layout redesign — the new two-panel responsive layout meets all requested acceptance criteria on desktop and mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthBrandPanel is correctly rendered on all four auth pages; .brandPanel is hidden below 900px via CSS (verified: not visible at 402x860 and no 'One trusted workspace' text in mobile body).
No horizontal overflow at 402px on either helper page — good responsive sizing on the card column.

All required data-testids exist and are stable across pages: login-form, login-email-input, login-password-input, login-password-toggle, login-submit-button, login-help-toggle (+ login-email-error / login-password-error / login-help-panel appear after interaction); forgot-form, forgot-email-input, forgot-submit-button, forgot-back-link (+ forgot-email-error on empty submit); reset-form, reset-password-input, reset-password-toggle, reset-submit-button (+ reset-password-error on <12 chars); accept-form, accept-email-input, accept-password-input, accept-password-toggle, accept-submit-button.
No raw JSON / stack traces / status codes / 'fetch'/'undefined'/'exception'/'502' text found anywhere in the four auth flows — safe-message contract intact.
Client-side validation still runs before any network call (login empty submit blocks navigation and shows inline messages) — enumeration-safety preserved.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for layout (8/8) + 6/6 verified regressions on /login and /password/forgot; 2 interactive regressions on /password/reset and /invitation/accept could not be re-clicked in this run due to the pre-existing preview WAF hydration issue, but data-testids and safe copy are correct in SSR.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The new two-panel auth layout is confirmed on all four pages at 1440x900 and correctly collapses to a single card at 402x860 with no horizontal overflow. To interactively verify click handlers on the preview URL you MUST use page.route to proxy any request matching /@, %00, __x00__, ?import, ?v= via urllib with User-Agent 'curl/8.0' and route.fulfill() — otherwise React hydration silently fails due to WAF blocking %00 in the vite-rsc virtual module URL. This is a preview-infra limitation only, not a code defect.
rca of the issue: Not a code issue. Layout requirements pass. Interactive verification limitation is the same iteration_1 root cause: vinext/vite-rsc emits virtual module URLs containing a NUL byte which browsers percent-encode to %00; the preview WAF blocks any path containing %00 with 403, so the browser cannot fetch the entry module and hydration silently fails. Reproduction: DevTools Network on the preview URL shows 403 for /@id/__x00__virtual:vite-rsc/entry-browser. Mitigation: whitelist %00 on the preview ingress for the dev module path, or serve a production vite build behind the preview URL, or patch vinext to avoid NUL in virtual ids.
